decision.observation: The booth shutter is still partly covering the window after the last handle click, and the next entrant is nearby; no passport has been presented.
decision.hypothesis: Waiting will let the shutter animation finish and the entrant reach the counter without another toggle.
decision.memory: Every entrant needs a passport; only Arstotzkan citizens may enter. Inspect nationality and expiration, stamp the passport, then drag it directly onto the entrant to return it. Avoid repeated shutter clicks during animation.
